title: Mission
description: A saved, named launch: one tool, its inputs, and an evidence folder. v1 allows exactly one step; sequences are deferred.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor validation. Ignored by the launcher.

mission.description: Mission schema version. v1 is the only version this schema accepts.

inputs.description: Names of the mission-level inputs a launch must resolve, e.g. [spec].

steps.description: The tool launch(es) inside this mission. v1 allows exactly one; the list shape stays forward-compatible with multi-step sequences.

tool.description: The catalogued tool's name this step launches.

with.description: Values for the tool's declared inputs[], by name.

evidence.description: Path this mission's evidence folder resolves to, one folder per run.
